test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

The young of a frog
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e.** "Tadpole".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **"tadpole" **is the term used for the young of a frog.
 
• It is the larval stage in the life cycle of an amphibian, particularly that of a frog or toad. (मेंढ़क का बच्चा)
